meta.title: Stroke Rehabilitation | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Stroke rehabilitation at Cambridge Hospital: a multidisciplinary team and personalised treatment plans to restore mobility, speech and independence after a stroke.

overview: Stroke rehabilitation at Cambridge Hospital is designed to support patients through structured recovery, helping restore function, improve mobility, and enhance independence following a stroke.
Our multidisciplinary approach ensures each patient receives personalized care tailored to their condition, recovery stage, and long-term goals.
